name: perdiem-monorepo
description: Per Diem Restaurant Menu Application - Full Stack Monorepo

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "blue,green"
scripts.build: node api.js && npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=client
scripts.clean: rimraf client/node_modules server/node_modules node_modules client/dist server/dist
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
